title: Guidelines / Masterbrand Elements

location.series: Jessie W. Lee / Verizon Master Brand Redesign

slide_intent: Give creators a clear starting point so they can find the guidance needed for a consistent execution.
strategic_value: A shared entry to masterbrand and channel guidance can reduce conflicting interpretations of Verizon’s identity.
demonstration: A laptop presents the Guidelines landing page, with a large Masterbrand Elements panel above cards for FAQs, 5G, apps and web.
practical_value: Organize foundational guidance before channel-specific implementation resources.

content_islands.name: Laptop context
content_islands.spec: Center the laptop on white and retain the complete screen and device silhouette.

content_islands.name: Guidance hierarchy
content_islands.spec: Place the Guidelines heading above the black Masterbrand Elements panel, then align the smaller topic cards underneath.

reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying case study explains that the online guidance replaces a 300+ page PDF and supports continuing updates.
reference_purposes.Application: The landing page separates foundational brand elements from app, web and other resource areas.
